newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pathe shares track BSkyB stock higher.
newsitem.headline: Pathe shares track BSkyB stock higher.

text.p: Shares in film company Pathe rose sharply on Monday, tracking a rally in BSkyB shares in London, brokers said.

Shares in Pathe, which holds a 17 percent stake in BSkyB, were up 5.08 percent at 1,200 francs at 1230 GMT as the British company's share rose 4.6 percent on a report in the Financial Times that it would invest 200 million sterling in digital decoders.

The share, which has been in decline since touching a year high of 1,526 francs on October 18, has also been helped by a report by brokerage Merrill Lynch issued on December 12 which said the share's 50 percent discount to the re-evaluated net assets of 2,251 francs per share was unjustified.
The share's recent weakness reflected concerns about the outlook for heightened competition in digital decoders.
Pathe was created this year when Chargeurs de-merged into two companies -- Pathe and the Chargeurs International textiles business.
Chargeurs transferred its 17 percent stake in BSkyB to Pathe, which has said it considers the holding a strategic asset.
